# anthropic_environment (Data Source)

Get information about an Environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_environment" "example" {
  id = "env_01HqR2k7vXbZ9mNpL3wYcT8f"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the Environment.

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String)
- `config` (Attributes) Container configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `created_at` (String)
- `name` (String) Name of the Environment.
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Read-Only:

- `networking` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--networking))
- `packages` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--packages))
- `type` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--config--networking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.networking`

Read-Only:

- `allow_mcp_servers` (Boolean)
- `allow_package_managers` (Boolean)
- `allowed_hosts` (List of String)
- `type` (String)


<a id="nestedatt--config--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.packages`

Read-Only:

- `apt` (List of String)
- `cargo` (List of String)
- `gem` (List of String)
- `go` (List of String)
- `npm` (List of String)
- `pip` (List of String)
